What kind of fish? Did you make the tacos yourself?

Yes I make the tacos myself. I use the Van De Kamps beer battered fish fillets that you can buy in the store, and I cook the fillets in the oven in comparison to frying.

Essentially the core ingredients/steps are as follows:

White sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup sour cream, 2 chopped jalapenos, and 1 juiced lime.

White corn tortillas that you essentially crisp over an open flame on the burners of your oven. Burning them slightly brings about a nice taste.

Put the cooked fish on the crisped corn tortillas, top with the white taco sauce, then add strips of red cabbage, along with chopped vidalia/sweet/yellow onions and green bell peppers. And wow! These are good.

The tacos usually always end up breaking in my hands since I over-top them with the veggies, but it's an enjoyable experience licking the sauce and lime juice off your fingers.
